sections.html: The mangrove crab Goniopsis pelii comes from the Atlantic coast of Africa. Its orange and blue coloured claws are very remarkable. It owes its name to the mangrove woods where it naturally occurs.
This biotope, affected by both water and land, has to be reproduced in the terrarium, since the crabs need both habitats for their well-being.

The land part can be arranged with some bogwood and stones; as the water part, a simple, flat basin filled with brackish water is sufficient. Some hard plants can complete the decoration. A tightly fitting, non-displaceable cover is necessary, particularly if the decoration reaches the edge of the aquarium, since crabs are notorious escapees.
As omnivores they are relatively easy to feed. In the water, frozen food can be fed; on land, vegetable food should be offered. Nearly all vegetables can be offered to the crabs.
